issue-4403: Is the byte order mark at the start of CSV exports deliberate?
Opened by warehouse-etl-ken on 2026-10-20

Our Python loader reads the first column of every Ledgerline CSV as `\ufeffDate`
instead of `Date`. A hex viewer shows the bytes EF BB BF at the start of the
file. Is that on purpose

This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.
src/export/csv.ts defines a BOM constant (U+FEFF) and defaults `bom: true` in writeCsv, with a comment explaining it is added deliberately so spreadsheet apps detect UTF-8 when a CSV is opened directly; this confirms the behavior is intentional and will persist, answering the reporter's question rather than indicating a bug to fix.
